entry.name: accentColor
entry.label: The accent colour of the tiles menu. Windows derives it from the system accent; here it is a free choice (pressed group title, group drag placeholder and the sidebar marker).

entry.name: compactMode
entry.label: Use the non-fullscreen Start menu (the Windows 10 windowed layout: sidebar, application list and a tile area whose width and height can be dragged).

entry.name: compactColumns
entry.label: Columns of groups in the windowed Start menu (1..4). Dragging the panel's right edge changes it.

entry.name: compactHeight
entry.label: Height of the windowed Start menu panel, in design pixels. Dragging the panel's top edge changes it.
